text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hm... Reopening of Japan in 1854!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I take it I've stumbled upon you bothplaying a
word chain game? The wordsseem somewhat
more out there than I'mused to...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice ear! In this version of the game,you
have to start with "r" and end with"r."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, and I wouldn't have it any easier.This
feeling of being on the edge ofdefeat... That's
what really gets the soulburning!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The edge of defeat... I see. Perhaps youcould
add even more rules, like notbeing able to use "r"
in the middle of aword, for example.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now, quite the ruthless lady wehave here!
We can crank the stakes uphigher for sure!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Flash, you're playing nowtoo! It's a
three-way battle to the end!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want me... to play?
